documents.extracted_text: Bharat Forge procures automotive-grade forging billets and specialty alloy steel from domestic integrated mills including Tata Steel.
Samvardhana Motherson sources flat and specialty steel inputs for polymer/metal assemblies from domestic steel majors including Tata Steel and JSW Steel.
Sundram Fasteners relies on alloy steel wire rods and bars from domestic primary mills including JSW Steel for high-tensile automotive fasteners.
Dilip Buildcon procures structural steel and TMT bars for highway and bridge EPC packages from primary producers including Tata Steel.
IRB Infrastructure's EPC construction arm sources reinforcement steel and girders from domestic flat and long steel suppliers including JSW Steel.
Maruti Suzuki sources forged powertrain and chassis components from Tier-1 domestic suppliers including Bharat Forge.
Tata Motors sources wiring harnesses, bumpers, and interior modules from Samvardhana Motherson across domestic passenger and commercial vehicle lines.
Sundram Fasteners supplies high-tensile engine and transmission fasteners to Tata Motors commercial and passenger vehicle plants.
Larsen & Toubro engages specialized highway/civil EPC subcontractors including Dilip Buildcon on select regional packages.
Tata Steel procures domestic thermal and coking coal allocations through Fuel Supply Agreements with Coal India subsidiaries.
NTPC relies on Coal India for the majority of domestic coal linkages powering its base-load thermal generation fleet.
UltraTech Cement sources domestic thermal coal for kiln and captive power plants from Coal India alongside imported petcoke.
Ambuja Cements maintains domestic coal supply linkages with Coal India for clinker kiln and captive thermal power operations.
Dilip Buildcon procures bulk OPC/PPC cement for highway bridges and pavement packages from UltraTech Cement.
Larsen & Toubro sources large-volume structural cement across metro and heavy civil projects from UltraTech Cement.
IRB Infrastructure procures highway-grade cement for BOT/TOT road packages from Ambuja Cements.
